fact: On 15 August 2025 the Minister replied that the DCDT established and operationalised a national CSIRT, the Cybersecurity Hub, in 2016 under the 2015 NCPF, and that the NCPF mandates the State Security Agency to coordinate national cybersecurity efforts.
title: Question NW4353 to the Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies
publisher: Parliamentary Monitoring Group (Parliament of South Africa)
